description: Compare 2 to 5 Dutch addresses in one call, in English: liveability, police-registered crime, average home value, floor area, year built, distances to train station, supermarket, primary school and GP, noise, air quality and ground height, plus the best address per metric and the full report for each. For relocation and house-hunting agents. Input: addresses separated by ';'. Costs $0.12 USDC via x402, or one unit of a Factline API key quota.

addresses.description: 2 to 5 Dutch addresses separated by ';', e.g. '3511LX 1; 2517AS 100'
